name: P ZERO Race TLR

origin.basis: Italian tire maker; Pirelli says the P ZERO Race range is made at its plant in Italy near its Milan headquarters.

manufacturing.basis: Pirelli: the P ZERO Race range is made in Italy (Bollate factory).

positioning: Pirelli's SpeedCORE tubeless road tire for racing and high-intensity long rides, with SmartEVO compound.
weight_basis: Pirelli black-sidewall claims per size; Classic and Retro editions differ slightly.
pressure_note: The product page gives no maximum pressure; use the figure printed on the tire.

wet_notes.summary: Pirelli says the SmartEVO compound gives grip in any weather condition.

availability.note: Listed in Pirelli's UK catalogue with a dealer finder and stocked by a US retailer on 2026-11-01; no mainland China listing was checked for this line.

price_observations.conditions: Retailer price on 2026-11-01 for the 28 mm black tire with local stock; the page does not state one tire or a pair.

caveats: Hookless compatibility and maximum pressure are not stated on the product page; follow the rim maker.
About 35 g heavier than the 5000 S TR at 28 mm, with more measured tread protection.

image.shown: P ZERO Race TLR sidewall as pictured in Pirelli's catalogue; one photo covers every width.
image.alt: Close-up of a Pirelli P ZERO Race TLR road tire sidewall

rights.usage_note: The maker's own product photo, shown from the maker's website; no copy is stored or redistributed by this project, and no license is asserted.
